listing.name: 5.5e SRD Oracle
listing.longDescription: Explore the redistributable 5.5e SRD catalog, create and continue characters, and play rule-faithful battles. Catalog browsing needs no account; standard MCP OAuth protects every persistent Play Session.

mcp.authenticationRationale: Catalog browsing is anonymous. Creating, reading, changing, listing, or deleting a persistent Play Session requires standard MCP OAuth with the play-sessions scope.

availability.rationale: The English-language SRD experience has no product-specific geographic dependency; the verified publisher must confirm countries it can legally support at submission time.

releaseNotes: Public SRD catalog browsing remains anonymous; every character and battle Play Session now requires OAuth and is saved from creation, with explicit listing and deletion controls.
contentBoundary: Redistributable SRD and visibly synthetic content only; no PHB+ authored identity or protected expression.
